in-81loPDFiwL.description: Millie is desperate for a fresh start, so when the wealthy Winchesters offer her a live-in job cleaning their beautiful Long Island home, it seems too good to be true. She gets a small room in the attic and a chance to leave her past behind. But Nina Winchester's moods swing wildly, the house hides unsettling secrets, and Millie soon realises that some doors are locked for a reason. The first book in the Housemaid series.

in-7144dxKjVL.description: The Art of War is the ancient Chinese treatise on military strategy attributed to the general Sun Tzu. Across thirteen concise chapters, it examines planning, leadership, deception, terrain and the value of knowing both yourself and your opponent. Written more than two thousand years ago, its ideas are still studied today by readers in business, sport, politics and everyday decision-making.

in-81Ypb9lrEQL.description: Leo Tolstoy's War and Peace follows several aristocratic Russian families as Napoleon's armies sweep across Europe and invade Russia. Through characters such as the restless Pierre Bezukhov, the ambitious Prince Andrei Bolkonsky and the spirited Natasha Rostova, the novel moves between glittering ballrooms and brutal battlefields. It is a sweeping portrait of love, ambition and history, presented here in a premium classic edition.

in-81t6xQeZA8L.description: In the summer of 1953, seventeen-year-old Roya escapes the political unrest gripping Tehran by losing herself in the poetry and books of a small neighbourhood stationery shop. There she meets Bahman, a passionate young idealist, and the two fall deeply in love. When a planned meeting in the town square goes wrong amid the upheaval of a coup, they are torn apart. Decades later, in America, Roya is given an unexpected chance to learn what really happened.

in-813P4lxRaLL.description: Aman Chandra, a seventeen-year-old from Delhi, is abruptly taken from his ordinary life along with ten other chosen teenagers and brought to Vanyasa, a secret Himalayan valley where gods, immortal yogis and mythical creatures live. Given one year to master yogic magic before a dangerous journey, Aman also begins to uncover the truth about his father. This Indian mythological fantasy blends adventure, friendship and ancient lore.
details: Enter the Valley of the Gods

in-81tmzGnqseL.description: This three-book set collects Kevin Missal's Kalki trilogy, a retelling inspired by the legend of Kalki, the tenth avatar of Vishnu. In the village of Shambhala, young Kalki Hari discovers extraordinary abilities and a destiny that sets him against the ruthless Kali, who holds power over the land. Across Avatar of Vishnu, Eye of Brahma and Sword of Shiva, the story unfolds as an epic of battles, loyalty and dharma.

in-81AFx0AuGL.description: This two-book set brings together classic detective fiction by Arthur Conan Doyle, featuring Sherlock Holmes and his loyal companion Dr John Watson. One volume collects The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes, a series of short cases solved through sharp observation and deduction, while the other gathers the complete Holmes novels, including A Study in Scarlet and The Hound of the Baskervilles. Set largely in Victorian London, the stories remain gripping today.

in-710oqNs2JL.description: The Novo Baby Smart Activity Fun & Learning Blocks set is a geometric shape sorter that helps little ones learn shapes and colours through hands-on play. in-71VAUdhYJGL.description: The Novo Baby Wooden ABCD Learning Board introduces toddlers and preschoolers to the alphabet through tactile, hands-on play. in-61vq6mEiQ7L.description: The Storio Montessori Talking Flash Cards make early learning interactive for children aged 2 to 5 years. in-A1dtQsoQEL.description: The Palace of Illusions retells the Mahabharata through the eyes of Panchaali, better known as Draupadi, who is born from fire and destined to change the course of history. From her lonely childhood in her father's palace to her marriage to the five Pandava brothers and the great war that follows, she shares her hopes, frustrations and complicated friendships. This 15th anniversary edition celebrates a much-loved feminist retelling of the epic.

in-61qTWmEi5GL.description: Newlyweds Tricia and Ethan are searching for their first home when a viewing leads them to the isolated manor of Dr Adrienne Hale, a psychiatrist who vanished without a trace years earlier. When a snowstorm traps them inside, Tricia stumbles on hidden recordings of Dr Hale's sessions with her patients. As she listens, the tapes reveal unsettling secrets, and Tricia starts to wonder whether she and Ethan are truly safe.

in-814n9NoAW4L.description: A failed bank robbery in a small Swedish town turns into a hostage situation when the would-be robber bursts into an apartment viewing full of strangers. Over one chaotic day, the hostages, including a retired couple, a banker and a young couple expecting a baby, reveal their fears, regrets and quiet kindnesses. Told with warmth and humour, Fredrik Backman's novel is a moving story about friendship, forgiveness and the anxieties we all carry.

in-71xxddxprOL.description: When her boyfriend casually announces he is marrying someone else, twenty-five-year-old Takako is left heartbroken and adrift. Her eccentric uncle Satoru offers her a free room above the Morisaki Bookshop, his second-hand store in Tokyo's Jimbocho book district. Though she has never been much of a reader, Takako slowly discovers the comfort of books, the quiet charm of the neighbourhood and new connections that help her begin again.

in-71APFtgsw4L.description: The Smartivity Montessori Slide Puzzle is a wooden learning toy for children aged 4 to 8 years. Kids slide pieces around the board to match colours and complete patterns, building logic, concentration and problem-solving skills as they go. in-71wtNAEfGEL.description: The VEBETO Kids Piano Keyboard is a portable electronic keyboard with 37 keys and a microphone, letting children play, sing and explore music.
